items.title: xRAT Malware Attacking Windows Users Disguised as Adult Game
items.description: A dangerous malware threat has emerged targeting Windows users across Korea through webhard file-sharing services. The Ahnlab Security Intelligence Center recently identified xRAT, also known as QuasarRAT, being distributed as fake adult games to unsuspecting users. items.title: ZDI-CAN-28894: Apple
items.description: A CVSS score 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Hossein Lotfi (@hosselot) of Trend Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-01-09, 10 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-05-09 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
